about.description:
Python CFFI binding around SuiteSparse::GraphBLAS. This is a base package that exposes
only the low level CFFI API bindings and symbols. This package is shared by the syntax
bindings pygraphblas and python-graphblas.

script: python -c "import suitesparse_graphblas as s; from suitesparse_graphblas import lib, ffi; s.initialize(); p = ffi.new('int32_t*'); assert lib.GrB_Global_get_INT32(lib.GrB_GLOBAL, p, lib.GxB_LIBRARY_OPENMP) == lib.GrB_SUCCESS; assert p[0], 'libgraphblas was built without OpenMP'"

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "10.5.1.1"
  # The first three parts of the version are the SuiteSparse:GraphBLAS version
  graphblas_version: ${{ (version | split("."))[:3] | join(".") }}

package:
  name: python-suitesparse-graphblas
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/s/suitesparse_graphblas/suitesparse_graphblas-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 9eadef09cc25a3fba48854329f2d1522f47baeb5edfc70365e9ca5a8c9992d38

build:
  number: 0
  skip: match(python, "<3.11")
  script:
    # The sdist ships a utils.c that was cythonized against numpy 2.5 and only compiles
    # with numpy >=2.5 headers; drop it so it is regenerated for the numpy used here.
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -c "import pathlib; pathlib.Path('suitesparse_graphblas/utils.c').unlink(missing_ok=True)"
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython
        - numpy
        - cffi
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77
    - setuptools-git-versioning
    - cffi
    - cython
    - graphblas ${{ graphblas_version }}.*
    - numpy
  run:
    - python
    - cffi >=1.15
    - numpy >=1.24

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - suitesparse_graphblas
      pip_check: true
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
    script:
      - python -c "import platform ; print(platform.machine())"
      # Fail loudly if libgraphblas was built without OpenMP. GraphBLAS only
      # warns at configure time and still builds a serial library, so this is
      # otherwise invisible: graphblas 10.5.0 shipped that way on osx-arm64
      # while still depending on llvm-openmp.
      - python -c "import suitesparse_graphblas as s; from suitesparse_graphblas import lib, ffi; s.initialize(); p = ffi.new('int32_t*'); assert lib.GrB_Global_get_INT32(lib.GrB_GLOBAL, p, lib.GxB_LIBRARY_OPENMP) == lib.GrB_SUCCESS; assert p[0], 'libgraphblas was built without OpenMP'"
      # Like upstream's wheel tests: warnings are errors, which catches e.g. the GIL
      # being re-enabled on free-threaded builds
      - pytest -v -W error --pyargs suitesparse_graphblas
